application: Master applies a preset only to the closed existing owned client, retaining exact previous configuration bytes/hashes and artifact identity. Keep rollback receipts and caches. Do not modify catalog or Packwiz concurrently.
benchmark: Keep resolution, power mode, route, world/checkpoint, actors, machine state and warm-cache state fixed. A locked 60 FPS requires frame-interval/spike evidence; a change of terrain or population invalidates a causal A/B comparison.
